Routine follow-up visit for hypertension and type 2 diabetes mellitus.

Patient reports taking lisinopril 10 mg daily and metformin 500 mg daily as prescribed. Denies chest pain, shortness of breath, palpitations, dizziness, edema, polyuria, polydipsia, or recent hypoglycemia. No acute concerns today. Medication tolerance is good without reported adverse effects.

Vital signs reviewed. Blood pressure is acceptable on current regimen. Weight and other vital signs documented in the chart.

Assessment: Hypertension, stable on lisinopril. Type 2 diabetes mellitus, without reported acute complications, on metformin. Preventive care and routine health maintenance reviewed.

Continue lisinopril 10 mg daily and metformin 500 mg as currently prescribed. Reinforce a heart-healthy, carbohydrate-conscious diet, regular physical activity as tolerated, and home blood pressure monitoring. Order or review hemoglobin A1c, comprehensive metabolic panel, urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio, lipid panel, and routine diabetes screening as due. Counsel on annual dilated eye examination, foot care, and avoiding NSAID overuse. Follow up in 3 months or sooner for new or worsening symptoms.
